name: findcheap-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog, find verified deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.6.6 searches Shopify Global Catalog, reserves EXACT for strong product identity, and renders evidence-rich product cards. When the user supplies a US ZIP, it may create a short-lived anonymous Shopify cart for each returned exact variant to obtain estimated shipping and an estimated total; unsupported merchants remain item-price-only and no tax or fee is invented. It queries a configured verified Deals API and binds persistent identity-specific price, promotion, inventory, and restock Watch rules to native Codex Automation. Without approved affiliate relationships it fails closed and uses canonical merchant links. User-authorized Chrome remains a bounded zero-result fallback. It never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Search products, find verified deals, or create and bind a Watch to Codex Automation. Never launch MCP.
